# Canon. Do not edit.

This page is the fixed reference for the demo world of the Lantern Coast. Everything on it is invented for the demo. Other documents may quote it; none may change it.

## The coast

The Lantern Coast is a long strip of cliffs, coves and small harbours on the western edge of the Salt Sea. Fog is common and storms come in autumn, so each headland carries a lantern tower. There are nine towers. The first is Harrowmere and the last is Pellam Sound.

## The towers

- Each tower is tended by one keeper and one apprentice.
- A tower is lit at dusk and put out at dawn, on every night of the year.
- The towers are numbered from the south: Harrowmere is first, Pellam Sound is ninth.
- A keeper who lets a tower go dark for a night is called before the Lantern Court at Quillhaven.

## The people

- Keepers wear grey wool coats with one brass button for each year of service.
- The harbour towns trade salted fish, glass floats and rope. Nobody uses coins on the water: a bargain is sealed with a knotted cord.
- Visitors are called "tide-guests" and are given bread and a bed for three nights.

## The calendar

The year has ten months of thirty-six days. The Ember Tide, the highest tide of the year, falls on the last night of the ninth month. On that night every tower burns a red lantern and the harbours hold a feast.

## Things that are never true

- No tower is ever built inland.
- Nobody sails past the ninth tower and returns.
- The fog is not alive.

This page is generic demo material. It belongs to no real game, book or film.
